title: Download Resume (PDF)
description: Download your resume directly as a high-quality PDF file (US Letter).
startOverConfirmDesc: This will clear all your current CV data and start fresh. This action cannot be undone.

instructions.step2: The PDF file will automatically download to your device without opening the print dialog.
instructions.step3: Document is formatted for US Letter (21.59 × 27.94 cm) with 1.5 cm margins.
instructions.step4: If content exceeds page height, subsequent pages are generated automatically.

errors.PRINT_NOT_SUPPORTED: Your browser does not support PDF generation.
errors.CV_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: CV document was not found on this page. Please navigate to the Builder first.
errors.CV_NOT_READY: Your CV is not ready for download. Please fill in the required fields.
errors.PRINT_FAILED: An error occurred while generating the PDF. Please try again.
